fato_historico: 1971: Oman declares its independence from the United Kingdom.
energia_do_dia: The cosmic currents suggest a day of liberation for you, Taurus. Much like a desert kingdom finding its own path to freedom, you may feel an urge to declare independence from outdated habits. It is a good time to establish your own rules, grounding your soul in newfound autonomy and building a stable empire of self-love that truly reflects your brilliant spirit.
frase_do_dia: Your freedom is the fertile soil where your greatest dreams finally begin to bloom.
significado_numero: Represents the manifestation of your personal power and inner strength.
conselho: Consider taking one small step today to honor your boundaries and authentic desires.
